title: Hi-Desert Nature Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: The Natural History Wing provides visitors with an engaging introduction to the remarkable biodiversity and geologic history of the Mojave Desert. Through immersive displays and authentic specimens, visitors can explore the plants, animals, and landscapes that make this desert ecosystem one of the most unique environments in North America. Desert Fauna Dioramas Realistic habitat dioramas showcase a variety of native wildlife, allowing visitors to observe desert animals within carefully recreated natural settings.
